description: This Java class 'ConfigurationModulesLoader' provides utility methods for serializing and deserializing integration configuration data to and from JSON format. It includes methods to convert a map of configurations into a JSON string and to load configurations from a JSON string into a map of 'IntegrationConfiguration' objects.

classes.name: ConfigurationModulesLoader
classes.description: Utility class for loading and converting integration configuration data to/from JSON format.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Converts a map of IntegrationConfiguration objects into a JSON array string.

methods.name: loadIntegrationConfigurations
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into a map of IntegrationConfiguration objects.
